---
title: Chapters when the template leaves headings unnumbered
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    include-before-body:
      - text: '#set heading(numbering: none)'
number-sections: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1: First' 'Figure 2: Second' 'See Figure 2' '(1)' 'Theorem 1' 'Note 1'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          if printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE '(Figure|Theorem|Note|Equation) \(?0\.'; then echo 'chapter prefix 0 found'; exit 1; fi
    typst:
      noErrors: default
---

# One

![First square.](figure.svg){#fig-one fig-alt="A blue square."}

# Two

![Second square.](figure.svg){#fig-two fig-alt="A blue square."}

$$
a = b
$$ {#eq-one}

::: {#thm-x}
## A theorem

A statement.
:::

::: {#nte-x .callout-note}
A note.
:::

See @fig-two, @eq-one, @thm-x and @nte-x.
